The '''Velocity Mercenaries''' were a group of [[Mercenary/Legends|mercenaries]] that operated in the [[Dantooine system/Legends|Dantooine system]] at the time of the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]]. They controlled an area of the Dantooine system known as the [[Area Ferionic 7-IK]] and were based at the [[Dantooine's Second Star]], an [[Iron/Legends|iron]] [[Planetoid/Legends|planetoid]] located in the [[Ferionic Nebula]]. After the [[Battle of Yavin/Legends|Battle of Yavin]], the Velocity Mercenaries and the forces of the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] battled for the control of Area Ferionic 7-IK.<ref name="SWG:DSS" />

In space battles, they flew [[Kihraxz assault fighter]]s, [[Ixiyen-class fast attack craft|''Ixiyen''-class fast attack crafts]], [[Rihkxyrk assault fighter]]s, [[X4 Gunship/Legends|X4 Gunships]]<ref name="SWG:TiEC">{{SWGcite|exp=JtL|type=space|Tap into Enemy Communications|Dantooine system}}</ref> and [[YT-1300 light freighter/Legends|YT-1300 freighters]].<ref name="SWG:ItMFC" />
{{Military-stub}}

==Behind the scenes==
The Velocity Mercenaries appeared in the [[2003]] [[Star Wars video games|video game]] [[Star Wars Galaxies|''Star Wars Galaxies: An Empire Divided'']], a [[Wikipedia:Massively multiplayer online role-playing game|massively multiplayer online roleplaying game]] developed by [[Sony]] Online Entertainment and published by [[LucasArts]],<ref name="SWG:DSS" /> prior to its closure on [[December 15]], [[2011]].<ref name="Shutdown">{{SonyCite|url=playerinfo|text=IMPORTANT INFORMATION ABOUT ''STAR WARS'' GALAXIES™}}</ref> The Velocity Mercenaries were added to the game with the release of the expansion pack [[Star Wars Galaxies: Jump to Lightspeed|''Jump to Lightspeed'']] on [[October 27]], [[2004]].<ref name="SWG:DSS" />
